$comment: First-load JS per route, gzip, in KB (docs/features/00 §6.3). `maxGzipKB` is the enforced ratchet; `targetGzipKB` is the product budget it must reach. The build measured 278.1 KB (Home) and 313.0 KB (Practice Hub) on 2026-10-01, so the ratchet is current + 5 %. Lower maxGzipKB whenever a change makes the bundle smaller; never raise it to make a build pass.
